controls.name: Multi-Factor Authentication Enabled
controls.description: All user accounts should have MFA enabled to prevent credential-based attacks.
controls.recommendation: Enable MFA for all user accounts, especially privileged accounts.

controls.name: Privileged Account Inventory
controls.description: Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all privileged accounts.
controls.recommendation: Document all administrative and privileged accounts with assigned owners.

controls.name: Password Policy Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce strong password policies including complexity and minimum length.
controls.recommendation: Configure password policy with minimum 14 characters, complexity requirements.

controls.name: Account Lockout Policy
controls.description: Configure account lockout after failed authentication attempts.
controls.recommendation: Set account lockout threshold to 5 attempts with 15-minute lockout duration.

controls.name: Account Lifecycle Management
controls.description: Implement automated account provisioning and deprovisioning processes.
controls.recommendation: Establish automated account creation, modification, and deletion workflows.

controls.name: Least Privilege Principle
controls.description: Users and services operate with minimum necessary permissions.
controls.recommendation: Review and reduce permissions to minimum required for job functions.

controls.name: Domain Administrator Protection
controls.description: Limit use of domain administrator accounts and protect credentials.
controls.recommendation: Use dedicated admin workstations and protect DA credentials.

controls.name: Local Administrator Disabled
controls.description: Built-in local administrator account should be disabled or secured.
controls.recommendation: Disable built-in administrator account or set strong unique password.

controls.name: Guest Account Disabled
controls.description: Built-in guest account should be disabled.
controls.recommendation: Disable the built-in guest account.

controls.name: Privileged Access Workstation
controls.description: Administrators use dedicated workstations for privileged tasks.
controls.recommendation: Deploy PAW (Privileged Access Workstation) for all administrative tasks.

controls.name: Service Account Management
controls.description: Service accounts are managed with strong controls and regular review.
controls.recommendation: Inventory and regularly review all service accounts.

controls.name: Default Account Renaming
controls.description: Default administrator and guest accounts are renamed or disabled.
controls.recommendation: Rename default admin account to a non-obvious name.

controls.name: Identity Access Review
controls.description: Regular access reviews are performed for all user accounts.
controls.recommendation: Conduct quarterly access reviews for all accounts.

controls.name: Authentication Monitoring
controls.description: Failed authentication attempts are monitored and alerted.
controls.recommendation: Monitor and alert on excessive failed logins.

controls.name: Credential Hygiene
controls.description: Credentials are rotated and managed according to policy.
controls.recommendation: Implement regular password rotation for privileged accounts.

controls.name: Microsoft Defender Antivirus Enabled
controls.description: Endpoint protection should be enabled and running on all systems.
controls.recommendation: Enable and monitor Microsoft Defender Antivirus on all endpoints.

controls.name: Real-time Protection Enabled
controls.description: Real-time malware protection should be enabled.
controls.recommendation: Enable real-time scanning and protection features.

controls.name: Antivirus Definitions Updated
controls.description: Antivirus definitions should be current and automatically updated.
controls.recommendation: Ensure automatic definition updates are configured.

controls.name: Windows Firewall Enabled
controls.description: Host-based firewall should be enabled on all network profiles.
controls.recommendation: Enable Windows Firewall for Domain, Private, and Public profiles.

controls.name: Firewall Default Deny
controls.description: Firewall should default to denying inbound connections.
controls.recommendation: Configure default deny for inbound connections except explicitly allowed.

controls.name: EDR Solution Deployed
controls.description: Endpoint Detection and Response solution is deployed on all endpoints.
controls.recommendation: Deploy EDR solution across all endpoints for advanced threat detection.

controls.name: Attack Surface Reduction Rules
controls.description: ASR rules are configured to prevent common attack techniques.
controls.recommendation: Enable Attack Surface Reduction rules in Microsoft Defender.

controls.name: BitLocker Drive Encryption
controls.description: Full disk encryption should be enabled on all endpoints.
controls.recommendation: Enable BitLocker encryption on all system and data drives.

controls.name: Secure Boot Enabled
controls.description: Secure Boot should be enabled to prevent bootkit attacks.
controls.recommendation: Enable Secure Boot in UEFI firmware settings.

controls.name: TPM Enabled
controls.description: Trusted Platform Module should be enabled and configured.
controls.recommendation: Enable TPM 2.0 for hardware-based security.

controls.name: Patch Management
controls.description: Security patches are applied within defined timeframes.
controls.recommendation: Establish patch management process with defined SLAs by severity.

controls.name: Local Administrator Rights Restricted
controls.description: Users should not have local administrator rights.
controls.recommendation: Remove local admin rights from standard users.

controls.name: UAC Enabled
controls.description: User Account Control should be enabled at high level.
controls.recommendation: Configure UAC to Always Notify.

controls.name: Credential Guard Enabled
controls.description: Credential Guard should be enabled to protect credentials in memory.
controls.recommendation: Enable Credential Guard on compatible systems.

controls.name: Device Guard Enabled
controls.description: Windows Defender Application Control should be configured.
controls.recommendation: Configure WDAC policies to allow only approved applications.

controls.name: Exploit Protection Configured
controls.description: Exploit protection features should be enabled.
controls.recommendation: Enable system-wide exploit protection settings.

controls.name: Controlled Folder Access
controls.description: Controlled folder access should be enabled to prevent ransomware.
controls.recommendation: Enable controlled folder access in Microsoft Defender.

controls.name: Network Protection Enabled
controls.description: Network protection should be enabled to block malicious domains.
controls.recommendation: Enable network protection in Microsoft Defender.

controls.name: Cloud-delivered Protection
controls.description: Cloud-delivered protection should be enabled for real-time threat intelligence.
controls.recommendation: Enable cloud-delivered protection in Microsoft Defender.

controls.name: Tamper Protection Enabled
controls.description: Tamper protection should be enabled to prevent security tool disabling.
controls.recommendation: Enable tamper protection in Microsoft Defender.

controls.name: SMBv1 Disabled
controls.description: SMBv1 protocol should be disabled to prevent known attacks.
controls.recommendation: Disable SMBv1 client and server features.

controls.name: PowerShell Logging Enabled
controls.description: PowerShell script block logging and module logging should be enabled.
controls.recommendation: Enable PowerShell Script Block Logging and Module Logging.

controls.name: PowerShell Execution Policy
controls.description: PowerShell execution policy should be restricted.
controls.recommendation: Set execution policy to RemoteSigned or AllSigned.

controls.name: PowerShell v2 Removed
controls.description: PowerShell version 2 should be removed from all systems.
controls.recommendation: Uninstall PowerShell 2.0 engine.

controls.name: Windows Event Logging
controls.description: Comprehensive event logging should be enabled and configured.
controls.recommendation: Enable and configure Windows event logging for security events.

controls.name: Audit Policy Configured
controls.description: Advanced audit policies should be configured for security monitoring.
controls.recommendation: Configure advanced audit policies for logon, object access, and privilege use.

controls.name: RDP Disabled or Restricted
controls.description: Remote Desktop Protocol should be disabled or strictly controlled.
controls.recommendation: Disable RDP where not required. Enable NLA and restrict access.

controls.name: RDP NLA Enabled
controls.description: Network Level Authentication should be enabled for RDP.
controls.recommendation: Enable Network Level Authentication for RDP connections.

controls.name: WinRM Restricted
controls.description: Windows Remote Management should be secured and restricted.
controls.recommendation: Configure WinRM to use HTTPS and restrict access.

controls.name: Legacy Protocols Disabled
controls.description: Legacy and insecure protocols should be disabled.
controls.recommendation: Disable LLMNR, NetBIOS, and WPAD where not required.

controls.name: LSA Protection Enabled
controls.description: LSA protection should be enabled to prevent credential extraction.
controls.recommendation: Enable RunAsPPL for LSA protection.

controls.name: WDigest Authentication Disabled
controls.description: WDigest authentication should be disabled to prevent plaintext password storage.
controls.recommendation: Disable WDigest authentication in registry.

controls.name: LM and NTLMv1 Disabled
controls.description: Legacy LM and NTLMv1 authentication should be disabled.
controls.recommendation: Configure NTLM to only allow NTLMv2 responses.

controls.name: Anonymous SID/Name Translation Disabled
controls.description: Anonymous SID/Name translation should be disabled.
controls.recommendation: Disable anonymous SID/Name translation.

controls.name: AutoPlay Disabled
controls.description: AutoPlay should be disabled to prevent automatic execution from removable media.
controls.recommendation: Disable AutoPlay for all media types.

controls.name: AutoRun Disabled
controls.description: AutoRun should be disabled for all drive types.
controls.recommendation: Disable AutoRun for all drives.

controls.name: Guest Access Disabled
controls.description: Guest access to SMB shares should be disabled.
controls.recommendation: Disable insecure guest logons to SMB shares.

controls.name: LLMNR Disabled
controls.description: Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution should be disabled.
controls.recommendation: Disable LLMNR via Group Policy.

controls.name: NetBIOS Disabled
controls.description: NetBIOS over TCP/IP should be disabled where not required.
controls.recommendation: Disable NetBIOS over TCP/IP on network adapters.

controls.name: WPAD Disabled
controls.description: Web Proxy Auto-Discovery should be disabled if not required.
controls.recommendation: Disable WPAD or configure DNS block.

controls.name: Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: Regular vulnerability scans are performed on all assets.
controls.recommendation: Implement weekly vulnerability scanning for all assets.

controls.name: Critical Vulnerability Patching
controls.description: Critical vulnerabilities are patched within 7 days.
controls.recommendation: Establish 7-day SLA for critical vulnerability remediation.

controls.name: KEV Remediation
controls.description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities are remediated within 14 days.
controls.recommendation: Establish 14-day SLA for CISA KEV remediation.

controls.name: Software Inventory
controls.description: Complete software inventory is maintained for all assets.
controls.recommendation: Implement automated software inventory solution.

controls.name: Unsupported Software Removal
controls.description: End-of-life and unsupported software is identified and removed.
controls.recommendation: Identify and remove or upgrade unsupported software.

controls.name: Patch Management Process
controls.description: Formal patch management process with testing and deployment.
controls.recommendation: Establish documented patch management process with testing.

controls.name: High Vulnerability Patching
controls.description: High vulnerabilities are patched within 30 days.
controls.recommendation: Establish 30-day SLA for high vulnerability remediation.

controls.name: Vulnerability Exception Process
controls.description: Formal process for vulnerability exceptions with risk acceptance.
controls.recommendation: Document vulnerability exception and risk acceptance process.

controls.name: Security Updates Monitoring
controls.description: Security updates from vendors are monitored and evaluated.
controls.recommendation: Subscribe to vendor security bulletins.

controls.name: Asset Discovery
controls.description: Automated asset discovery is performed across the network.
controls.recommendation: Implement automated network asset discovery.

controls.name: Configuration Management
controls.description: Secure baseline configurations are maintained and enforced.
controls.recommendation: Implement configuration management with baseline enforcement.

controls.name: Vulnerability Risk Scoring
controls.description: Vulnerabilities are prioritized using risk-based scoring beyond CVSS.
controls.recommendation: Implement EPSS and KEV-based vulnerability prioritization.

controls.name: Third-party Patching
controls.description: Third-party applications are included in patch management.
controls.recommendation: Include third-party applications in patch management process.

controls.name: Medium Vulnerability Patching
controls.description: Medium vulnerabilities are patched within 90 days.
controls.recommendation: Establish 90-day SLA for medium vulnerability remediation.

controls.name: Vulnerability Reporting
controls.description: Regular vulnerability reports are generated and reviewed.
controls.recommendation: Generate monthly vulnerability reports for stakeholders.

controls.name: Network Firewall Deployed
controls.description: Network firewalls are deployed at all network boundaries.
controls.recommendation: Deploy firewalls at internet, DMZ, and internal boundaries.

controls.name: Network Segmentation
controls.description: Network is segmented to limit lateral movement.
controls.recommendation: Implement network segmentation with VLANs and ACLs.

controls.name: Remote Access Security
controls.description: Remote access is secured with VPN and MFA.
controls.recommendation: Require VPN with MFA for all remote access.

controls.name: VPN Security
controls.description: VPN uses strong encryption and secure configuration.
controls.recommendation: Configure VPN with AES-256 encryption and strong authentication.

controls.name: Secure Protocols Only
controls.description: Only secure protocols are allowed through firewalls.
controls.recommendation: Block insecure protocols and enforce TLS 1.2+.

controls.name: DNS Security
controls.description: DNS is secured with DNSSEC and filtering.
controls.recommendation: Implement DNSSEC and DNS filtering for malicious domains.

controls.name: Ingress Filtering
controls.description: Ingress filtering is applied to block malicious traffic.
controls.recommendation: Configure ingress filtering at network perimeter.

controls.name: Egress Filtering
controls.description: Egress filtering prevents data exfiltration.
controls.recommendation: Configure egress filtering to limit outbound connections.

controls.name: Network Monitoring
controls.description: Network traffic is monitored for anomalies.
controls.recommendation: Deploy network monitoring and IDS/IPS solutions.

controls.name: Wireless Security
controls.description: Wireless networks use WPA3 and strong authentication.
controls.recommendation: Configure wireless with WPA3-Enterprise and 802.1X.

controls.name: DMZ Architecture
controls.description: Public-facing services are in isolated DMZ segments.
controls.recommendation: Isolate public-facing services in DMZ network segments.

controls.name: Port Security
controls.description: Unused network ports are disabled or blocked.
controls.recommendation: Disable unused network ports and implement port security.

controls.name: Zero Trust Network
controls.description: Zero trust principles are applied to network architecture.
controls.recommendation: Implement zero trust network access (ZTNA) principles.

controls.name: Network Device Hardening
controls.description: Network devices are hardened according to benchmarks.
controls.recommendation: Apply CIS benchmarks to all network devices.

controls.name: Network Time Synchronization
controls.description: All systems synchronize time to trusted NTP sources.
controls.recommendation: Configure all systems to use internal NTP servers.

controls.name: Application Allowlisting
controls.description: Only approved applications are allowed to execute.
controls.recommendation: Implement application allowlisting using WDAC or AppLocker.

controls.name: Unsigned Application Blocking
controls.description: Unsigned or untrusted applications are blocked from execution.
controls.recommendation: Block execution of unsigned applications in user profiles.

controls.name: Browser Security
controls.description: Web browsers are configured with security settings.
controls.recommendation: Configure browser security policies and extensions.

controls.name: Office Macro Security
controls.description: Office macros are restricted to prevent malware execution.
controls.recommendation: Disable macros from internet or block all macros by default.

controls.name: Office OLE Blocking
controls.description: Office OLE package embedding is blocked.
controls.recommendation: Block OLE package embedding in Office documents.

controls.name: Script Host Restriction
controls.description: Windows Script Host is restricted or disabled.
controls.recommendation: Disable Windows Script Host if not required.

controls.name: PDF Reader Security
controls.description: PDF readers are configured to prevent automatic execution.
controls.recommendation: Disable JavaScript in PDF readers and block embedded content.

controls.name: Application Updates
controls.description: Applications are automatically updated to latest versions.
controls.recommendation: Enable automatic updates for all applications.

controls.name: Unnecessary Software Removal
controls.description: Unnecessary software and services are removed.
controls.recommendation: Remove unnecessary applications and services from endpoints.

controls.name: Application Isolation
controls.description: High-risk applications run in isolated environments.
controls.recommendation: Run high-risk applications in sandboxed environments.

controls.name: Email Security
controls.description: Email filtering blocks malicious attachments and links.
controls.recommendation: Deploy email filtering with attachment and URL scanning.

controls.name: DLL Search Order Hijacking Prevention
controls.description: DLL search order is secured to prevent hijacking.
controls.recommendation: Configure SafeDLLSearchMode and restrict DLL loading paths.

controls.name: Data Encryption at Rest
controls.description: Sensitive data is encrypted at rest on all systems.
controls.recommendation: Implement encryption at rest for all sensitive data.

controls.name: Data Encryption in Transit
controls.description: Data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher.
controls.recommendation: Enforce TLS 1.2+ for all data in transit.

controls.name: Data Classification
controls.description: Data is classified according to sensitivity levels.
controls.recommendation: Implement data classification scheme with handling procedures.

controls.name: Data Backup
controls.description: Regular backups are performed and tested.
controls.recommendation: Implement automated backup with regular restore testing.

controls.name: Backup Encryption
controls.description: Backups are encrypted and stored securely.
controls.recommendation: Encrypt backups and store in secure offsite locations.

controls.name: Backup Testing
controls.description: Backup restoration is tested regularly.
controls.recommendation: Test backup restoration quarterly.

controls.name: Data Loss Prevention
controls.description: DLP controls prevent unauthorized data exfiltration.
controls.recommendation: Implement DLP controls for sensitive data.

controls.name: Removable Media Control
controls.description: Removable media usage is controlled and monitored.
controls.recommendation: Restrict and monitor removable media usage.

controls.name: Secure Data Disposal
controls.description: Data is securely disposed when no longer needed.
controls.recommendation: Implement secure data disposal procedures.

controls.name: Key Management
controls.description: Encryption keys are managed securely.
controls.recommendation: Implement secure key management and rotation.

controls.name: Screen Lock
controls.description: Systems lock after period of inactivity.
controls.recommendation: Configure screen lock after 5 minutes of inactivity.

controls.name: Clipboard Security
controls.description: Sensitive data in clipboard is managed and cleared.
controls.recommendation: Implement clipboard management for sensitive data.

controls.name: Print Security
controls.description: Printing of sensitive data is controlled and logged.
controls.recommendation: Implement print control and logging for sensitive documents.

controls.name: Security Logging
controls.description: Security events are logged on all systems.
controls.recommendation: Enable and configure security logging on all systems.

controls.name: Centralized Logging
controls.description: Logs are forwarded to centralized logging platform.
controls.recommendation: Deploy centralized logging with SIEM integration.

controls.name: Log Retention
controls.description: Logs are retained for adequate forensic analysis.
controls.recommendation: Retain security logs for minimum 90 days online, 1 year archived.

controls.name: SIEM Deployment
controls.description: SIEM solution is deployed for security event correlation.
controls.recommendation: Deploy SIEM for centralized security monitoring and correlation.

controls.name: Security Alerting
controls.description: Security alerts are configured and monitored.
controls.recommendation: Configure security alerts for critical events.

controls.name: Incident Response Plan
controls.description: Incident response plan is documented and tested.
controls.recommendation: Document and regularly test incident response plan.

controls.name: Threat Intelligence
controls.description: Threat intelligence is consumed and applied.
controls.recommendation: Subscribe to threat intelligence feeds and apply IOCs.

controls.name: Security Metrics
controls.description: Security metrics and KPIs are tracked.
controls.recommendation: Define and track security metrics and KPIs.

controls.name: Anomaly Detection
controls.description: Anomaly detection is configured for unusual activities.
controls.recommendation: Configure behavioral analytics for anomaly detection.

controls.name: Security Awareness
controls.description: Security awareness training is provided to all users.
controls.recommendation: Conduct quarterly security awareness training.
